pin/pin_entering.doc: PIN entering — the eight-ring input, typed with the two buttons.

exceptions.reason: the PIN entry is an ENTRY, not an ending: its duration is the typed row plus whichever verdict tail follows, so the 2450 ms result hold does not apply to the screen as a whole (the tail inside it does rest 2450). The rule should arguably skip interactive screens.

verdict/padlock.doc: Padlock — the shackle turns in and clicks shut, or springs open.

exceptions.reason: the padlock re-derives the entrance inline because it overrides T_IN to its whole mechanism window (1070 lock / 1600 unlock), so VerdictAnim's u is the mechanism's progress, not the entrance's. The fix is the same as V-TIN's: move the mechanism into T_WAIT and let the inherited entrance() run. Output is identical today — this is a structural exception, not a visual one.

padlock lock spends its whole mechanism (turn-in 520 -> drop 260 -> click 290) inside T_IN instead of T_WAIT, so T_IN reads as a 1070 ms entrance. The icon's own fade + rise still finish within ARRIVE_MS — the law is obeyed on screen, only the bookkeeping differs.
